scoring_justification: Main claim values (static n and ε2 peaks) are compared against paper-reported gold within tolerances; full recompute from raw dielectric data is infeasible because raw ε(ω) is not a required output artifact. Reflectivity spectrum is scored structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for static refractive indices and ε2 peak parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: n(0)=13.93 (E⊥c), 8.13 (E//c); ε2 main peak for E⊥c at 0.01 eV mag 55.23; for E//c at 0.82 eV mag 25.33. Extracted from narrative and Fig. 3(b).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are explicit numeric results stated in the paper.

outputs.description: Static refractive indices, main ε2 peak parameters, and elastic constants (c11, c33, c44, c66, c12, c13, B0) for rutile RuO2; compared to paper-reported values with tolerances.
Reflectivity spectrum for structural checks (values in [0,1], qualitative shape consistency).

output_contract.notes: Optical and elastic properties combined into optical_summary.json; reflectivity_spectrum.csv is a low‑weight structural audit.
